notes.raw:
\*Data above 298 K estimated. Mo $_{2}$ S $_{3}$ metastable below 900 K. Phase changes: 2080 K, melting point of $Mo_{2}S_{3}$ ; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 31.000kcal/mol$ . 2140 K, decomposition point of $Mo_{2}S_{3}$ . Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations:
298.15-2080 K: $Cp^o$ = 26.360 + 7.880x $10^{-3}$ T - 2.300x $10^5$ T $^{-2}$
2080-2140 K: $H^o$ - $H_{298}^o$ = 26.360x $10^{-3}$ T + 3.940x $10^{-6}$ T $^2$ + 2.300x $10^2$ T $^{-1}$ - 8.981 $Cp^o$ = 37.500
$H^o$ - $H_{298}^o$ = 37.500x $10^{-3}$ T + 16.004
Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -145.805 + 5.091 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 1.090 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 245.950 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -145.805 - 5.091 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 1.090 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 122.975 \text{T}^{-1} + 104.113 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
2000-2080 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -142.730 + 3.341 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 1.420 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 1541.600 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -142.730 - 3.341 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 1.420 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 770.800 \text{T}^{-1} + 90.154 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
2080-2140 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -117.745 + 14.481 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 2.520 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 1771.600 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -117.745 - 14.481 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 2.520 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 885.800 \text{T}^{-1} + 155.084 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Source: Data from Chase (17) who estimated all above 298 K.
